title: Pressure ulcers: site, stage and healing
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's pressure ulcer, if any.
note:
Chief Complaint: Wound care for right heel.

HPI: Copied Forward: Patient is an 83-year-old male who presents for ongoing management of a pressure ulcer located on the right heel. The patient reports the area remains tender but notes no new drainage or increased pain since the last evaluation. He continues to use a pressure-redistributing mattress at home.

Vitals: BP 138/82, HR 76, SpO2 96% on room air, Temp 98.4 F.

Review of Systems:
Constitutional: Negative
Integumentary: Positive (wound site)
Musculoskeletal: Negative
Neurological: Negative

Medication List:
Lisinopril 10mg daily
Atorvastatin 20mg daily
Aspirin 81mg daily

Exam:
General: Alert and oriented x3, in no acute distress.
Skin: Examination of the right heel reveals a pressure ulcer. The wound bed is visible and the surrounding skin is intact. No purulent drainage or systemic symptoms noted.

Assessment:
Pressure ulcer on the right heel.

Plan:
1. Continue current wound care regimen.
2. Apply topical dressing to the pressure ulcer on the right heel.
3. Continue pressure-redistributing surface at home.
4. Follow up in 2 weeks for wound assessment.

Electronically signed, M. Okafor, MD, 05/14/2026
explanations: Pressure ulcer of the right heel, stage not documented: L89.619 (no HCC).

distractors.why: No stage is documented: use the unspecified-stage code.
